snippet.title: Path of Exile 1: Curse of the Allflame Releases on July 24 PDT
snippet.description:
Beneath the deep, an ancient curse awaits.

Find out everything you need to know about our new Path of Exile 1 expansion during the live reveal at 1 PM PDT on July 16 at twitch.tv/pathofexile!

Play Curse of the Allflame for free on PC and consoles starting July 24 (PDT).
